title: The Outcast of the Golden Calf
intro: A figure mentioned in the Quran led a great multitude into deviation during the absence of a noble prophet. Something crafted from gold captured the hearts of an entire nation — but the story of this individual ends in solitude and a strange curse. Who could this outcast be?
clues: I emerged during the absence of a great prophet who had ascended to receive divine guidance.
I caused a great multitude to go astray with something I crafted with my own hands.
The golden creation I produced seemed to have life, producing sounds that mesmerized those who followed it.
I claimed to have seen what others could not perceive — a glimpse into the unseen.
I drew something from the tracks of the divine messenger and cast it into molten metal.
I was condemned to wander alone, with a unique curse that none could touch my skin nor I touch theirs.

options: Created a golden calf for worship

outcome.answer: Exiled, forbidden from being touched or touching others

arabic: قَالَ فَإِنَّا قَدْ فَتَنَّا قَوْمَكَ مِنۢ بَعْدِكَ وَأَضَلَّهُمُ ٱلسَّامِرِىُّ
verse: [Allāh] said, "But indeed, We have tried your people after you [departed], and the Sāmirī has led them astray." (20:85)
